A current-looking Ansys/Synopsys company-information page contains a stale or contradictory FAQ line saying 'Ansys is a publicly traded company listed on the NASDAQ-100 Index (ANSS),' which conflicts with the 2025-07-17 acquisition-completion release stating Ansys stock would no longer trade on Nasdaq; I therefore relied on the dated completion release and Synopsys investor FAQ as stronger lifecycle evidence.
